messages:
elaine: Quick sync - we have 18 DP leads for the Optimizer. Need a transparent selection scoreboard and closure plan by Fri.

sophie: Agreed. I'll own the intake + public one-pager. Will publish weights.

raj: Runtime ask: we must expose p50/p95, tokens_per_request, cost_per_1k and a dp_tag before routing. ETA 48h?

ana: @ana here. NDA template at /legal/dp-nda. Tag dp-urgent for fast review. Partners sending protected data must be blocked until legal clears.

ben: Minimal metric list for dashboards: p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, tokens_per_request, cost_per_1k, error_rate_5m. I'll add dp_event markers.

elaine: Selection rubric draft: workload (40%), eng-readiness (25%), impact (20%), story value (10%), compliance risk (5%). Publish the sheet.

sophie: Tie-breakers: higher tokens/day, earlier start, willingness to be a reference. I'll build the spreadsheet.

onboard-bot: Created scaffold tickets for top 10 per draft rubric and added weekly sync placeholders. Links posted in #product.

raj: I'll add smart-routing flag dp_priority:N and a fallback lane to avoid experiments impacting production.

elaine: Incentive package: $5k cloud credits + 6mo Optimize + co-marketing. Close recruitment at 10 confirmed or Fri EOD. I'll publish intake link once Sophie shares.
